"Privacy Policy" "Welcome to our hotel booking application. Your privacy is our top priority." "Last updated: 07/03/2026\nVersion: 1.0.0-stable"
"1. Information Collection" "We collect basic information to identify users including Full Name, Phone Number, and Email Address through Firebase Authentication. In addition, the application may record device information and IP addresses to ensure the security of your account." "2. Data Usage" "Your data is used for purposes such as confirming hotel bookings, providing support when issues occur, and applying promotional codes (Vouchers) accurately. We are committed to not selling or sharing your personal information with third parties for advertising purposes." "3. Storage and Security" "All transaction information, booking history, and promotional data are stored on the Google Firestore cloud platform. We apply strict security standards and authentication rules (Security Rules) to prevent unauthorized access from external sources." "4. User Rights" "You have full rights to access and edit your personal information in the Profile section. In particular, we provide a \"Delete Account\" feature. When used, all your identifiable data on the Firebase system will be completely removed to ensure the user\'s right to be forgotten." "5. Third-Party Services" "The application uses services from Google Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Storage). These services also comply with Google\'s global privacy policies. You can learn more by visiting the Google Cloud Privacy Policy page." "6. Contact and Complaints" "If you have any questions about how we handle your data, you can contact the development team directly through the \"Support\" section in the application or send an email to the system\'s official support address."
1. Hotel Information Management We collect information provided by you including Hotel Name, Address, and Room details. This data is stored to display correctly to users seeking accommodations. 2. Visual Content & Media The images you upload to the Media Library are stored on Firebase and used to represent your hotel. You are responsible for the copyright and appropriateness of these images. 3. Data Integrity Management actions such as updating prices, managing vouchers, or hiding reviews are recorded to maintain system consistency and provide accurate reports in the Operations Center. 4. Administrative Account Policy To ensure the stability of the hotel data system, Admin accounts do not have the \"Self-Delete\" feature. Please contact the System Administrator if you need to deactivate your management account.
"Terms of Service" "By using our application, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully."
"1. Acceptance of Terms" "By accessing and using this hotel booking application, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy." "2. Booking and Payments" "All bookings are subject to availability. Once a booking is initiated, you must complete the payment within the specified countdown time (Timer). Failure to do so will result in an automatic cancellation of the booking to release the room for other users." "3. Voucher and Promotions" "Vouchers have specific conditions, including minimum order value, expiration date, and usage limits. We reserve the right to void a voucher if we detect any fraudulent activity or if the voucher has reached its maximum global usage limit." "4. Cancellation and Refunds" "• Cancellation Window: You may cancel and receive a 100% refund only if the request is made at least 24 hours before the scheduled check-in time.\n• Late Cancellation: No cancellations or refunds will be granted if requested within 24 hours of the check-in time.\n• No-show Policy:\n - 6 hours after the scheduled check-in time: If the guest has not confirmed check-in on the app, the Administrator reserves the right to mark the booking as a No-show without refund (unless a late arrival request was previously approved).\n - 12 hours after check-in: The system will automatically mark the booking as No-show and forfeit the refund, regardless of any prior requests." "5. User Responsibilities" "Users must provide accurate personal and guest information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and for all activities that occur under your account authenticated via Firebase." "6. Limitation of Liability" "We act as an intermediary between users and hotels. We are not liable for any direct or indirect damages arising from the hotel\'s service quality, or any technical issues caused by third-party services like internet providers or payment gateways."
1. Partner Responsibilities By registering as a Hotel Administrator, you agree to provide accurate information regarding room availability, pricing, and hotel facilities. You are responsible for all content uploaded via your account. 2. Booking & No-show Management Admins have the right to manage the booking lifecycle. According to system policy:\n• After 6 hours of scheduled check-in: Admin may manually mark a guest as No-show if they have not arrived.\n• After 12 hours: The system will automatically execute No-show status to release the room. 3. Voucher & Promotion Policy When creating Vouchers in the Operations Center, you acknowledge that these discounts will directly affect your hotel\'s displayed revenue. Once a voucher is applied to a confirmed booking, it cannot be revoked. 4. Content Moderation (Reviews) Admins are granted the right to hide reviews containing inappropriate language or fraudulent content. However, the numeric rating (stars) will remain in the system to ensure overall statistical transparency. 5. Revenue & Reports Revenue data displayed in the Operations Center is for reporting and management purposes. You are responsible for verifying these figures with your actual bank statements and internal accounting. 6. Account Stability & Data Integrity To protect the history of bookings and financial records, Admin accounts cannot be self-deleted. Any request for account deactivation must be submitted to the System Developer for manual processing.
